newsitem.title: USA: American Phoenix ships wireless internet.
newsitem.headline: American Phoenix ships wireless internet.

text.p: American Phoenix Group Inc said Friday its Tetherless Access Ltd have begun shipping the 2002 series of wireless metropolitan area networking products to provid high speed wireless data communications in rural areas and developing economies.

"We are making the first shipments of the 2002 series networking products to" the Bank of China in Shandong Province which is creating metropolitan area intranets; a public wireless internet in Manila, Philippines, jointly owned by Tetherless Access and a local telecommunications company which provides high speed wireless public internet access; and the Beijing Tourism Administration which is creating a wireless intranet linking hotels into the internet.

Tetherless Access is the U.S. operating and product development arm of Tetherless Access Asia Ltd, an Australian based telecommunications services company which American Phoenix has agreed to acquire.

As a result of the acquistion, which is to close in 14 days, American Phoenix said, it will be about 60 percent owned by Tetherless' principal owners -- BKP Partners ; the JGL Group, one of Australia's largest private companies, Clime Asset Management ; and the Greenchip Group.
